description: This PHP file defines a class AlertsViewDefault, which extends SugarView, and handles the display logic for the 'Alerts' view in the SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for setting the module title, pre-display setup, and rendering the template with assigned variables.

classes.name: AlertsViewDefault
classes.description: A view class for the 'Alerts' module, responsible for rendering the default view template and setting the module title.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the module title parameters, specifically 'Alerts'.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Hook method for pre-display logic; currently empty.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles rendering of the default template with assigned variables and terminates execution.
